contract.task_clause:
A nation is producing at a point inside of its production possibility curve. Which of the following is a possible explanation for this outcome?
Option A: This nation has experienced a permanent decrease in its production capacity.
Option B: This nation has experienced slower than usual technological progress.
Option C: This nation has avoided free trade between other nations.
Option D: This nation is experiencing an economic recession.
